subject: Service onboarding: initial tenant launch & API access plan
messages:
From: Carolina Gomez <carolina@waypointhealth.com>
To: monica.patel@redwood.com
Cc: Elliot Shaw <elliot@waypointhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New tenant kickoff: Waypoint initial access

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — we are ready to start the onboarding for our initial tenant. We have two engineers (Elliot and me) and a procurement contact who will be looped in shortly. High-level asks from our side:

- Create a dedicated tenant for Waypoint Health with isolated API keys
- Seed one admin user and two developer service accounts
- Short timeline: we’d like admin access by next Tuesday (2028-07-25) to begin integration testing

Can you share your recommended first-week plan, any required docs, and who from your side will be our day-to-day contact? Also please let us know if there are any contractual or PO steps we should expect in parallel.

Appreciate it —
Carolina
Carolina Gomez
Head of Platform 
Waypoint Health

From: monica.patel@redwood.com
To: Carolina Gomez <carolina@waypointhealth.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Jul 2028 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New tenant kickoff: Waypoint initial access

Hi Carolina —

Welcome — excited to get Waypoint onboarded. Quick summary and what I propose for the first week:

1) Day 0 (today): intake + access matrix — I’ll confirm the admin seed list and invite template. (See attached org-admin-invite-template.docx)
2) Day 1-2: Tenant provisioning & API key seed — Jonas will provision the tenant and create one org-admin and two service accounts; keys will be deposited into your secure S3 bucket or shared Drive per your preference.
3) Day 3: Integration smoke tests — we’ll run a guided smoke test with your engineers (15–30m).
4) Day 4-5: Harden permissions, rotate keys into your secret manager, and document roles.

Owners: Jonas (provisioning lead), Ben (implementation engineer), me (CS lead / escalation).

A couple of notes: we recommend seeding ephemeral keys for the dev accounts (short TTL) and keeping the org-admin as a named human account. We’ll also provide a short API key warmup guide (I’ll attach).

If that sounds good, I’ll schedule a 30-minute kickoff tomorrow at 10:00 PT.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0134

Attachment: org-admin-invite-template.docx
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: monica.patel@redwood.com, Carolina Gomez <carolina@waypointhealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Jul 2028 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New tenant kickoff: Waypoint initial access

Carolina / Monica —

I’ll provision the tenant this afternoon. Implementation checklist I’ll follow:

- Create workspace: waypoint-prod-001 (isolated namespace)
- Create roles: org-admin (human, MFA required), dev-service (machine, short TTL), svc-analytics (machine)
- Generate API keys: 1 org-admin key (manual seed), 2 service keys (ephemeral, 24h TTL)
- Add initial RBAC: admin -> full, dev-service -> generate/ingest only, svc-analytics -> embeddings only
- Provide a short script to put keys into your vault and rotate after first successful call

Carolina — for the key delivery, do you prefer: (A) secure Drive share + audit log, or (B) S3 presigned + one-time password? We can support either.

I’ll post the tenant id and seed fingerprints to the Drive after provisioning.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Elliot Shaw <elliot@waypointhealth.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Jul 2028 12:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New tenant kickoff: Waypoint initial access

Thanks Jonas —

We prefer S3 presigned + OTP for the keys. For the admin seed, I’ll send a short list of two people (Carolina and Elliot) and one shared breakglass admin (procurement will confirm the name). Can you also include the short smoke-test steps you mentioned? We want to validate token creation, a short generation call, and an embeddings call.

Elliot

From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: Carolina Gomez <carolina@waypointhealth.com>, monica.patel@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Jul 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New tenant kickoff: Waypoint initial access

Carolina — quick procurement note (cc Aditya):

- We typically run onboarding while the PO is in flight, provided there’s a signed MSA or mutual e-mail confirmation of scope. If Procurement prefers, we can gate key activation until a PO is issued — let us know.
- I’m attaching the API key warmup doc for the smoke tests (api-key-warmup-instructions.pdf).

Aditya — can you confirm the standard credit hold process if procurement requests invoice terms?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Implementation Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: api-key-warmup-instructions.pdf
From: aditya.rao@redwood.com
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, Carolina Gomez <carolina@waypointhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@waypointhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New tenant kickoff: Waypoint initial access

Hi all —

Procurement / Waypoint team: happy to coordinate payment terms. Standard approach: we can start provisioning and issue trial access while the PO is routed; active production keys and reserved capacity are gated on a signed PO or executed order form. If you need invoice terms (Net 30), we can accommodate via our billing team — I’ll mirror any payment questions to billing.

Next steps consolidated:
- Jonas: provision workspace today and post tenant id + key delivery method (S3 presigned + OTP) to the Drive link above.
- Carolina / Elliot: share the two admin user emails and confirm the breakglass admin name by EOD tomorrow.
- Monica: schedule 30m kickoff for 2028-07-18 10:00 PT (please confirm) — I’ll standby for procurement clarifications.

I’ll also open a DocuSign envelope with the standard order form if you’d like to sign electronically — Procurement, please advise.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
